															Short Information :
															Indian Air Force (CASB)  has Officially Released Exam City/ Admit Card for MALE INDIAN/ GORKHA (A SUBJECT OF NEPAL) citizens from all States and UTs for selection test from 2026 onwards to join Indian Air Force as Airmen in the Group ‘Y’ Medical Assistant trade (Intake 02/2027) Vacancy 2026. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to IAF Airmen Jobs. Exam Held On September 22-23, 2026 & Exam City Released On September 11, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Exam City Details Now in the Given Link Below. 
														
													
												

												 

												
													
														
															
															Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena)

															Central Armed Selection Board

															Group "Y" / Medical Assistant Airmen Recruitment 2026 (Intake 02/2027)
															
														
														
															
															WWW.RESULTBHARAT.COM
															
														
														
															
															Application Fee

															
																All Candidates : Rs. 550/-
																GST Charge: Extra
																Payment Mode: Pay Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking  Fee Mode.
															
															
															
															Important Dates

															
																Online Apply Start : 06 July 2026
																Last Date for Apply: 26 July 2026
																Last Date for Fee Payment : 26 July 2026
																Exam City Intimation: 11 September 2026
																Admit Card: 24-48 Hours Before the Exam Date     
																Exam Start Date: 22-23 September 2026  
															
															
														
														
															
															Age Limit

															
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with 10+2):- Candidate should be unmarried and born  between 01 July 2006 and 01 July 2010 (both dates inclusive).
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy):- Unmarried candidate shouldbe born between 01 July 2003 and 01 July 2008 (both dates inclusive). Married candidate should be born between 01 July 2003 and 01 July 2006  (both dates inclusive).
																In case, a candidate clear all the stages of the Selection Procedure, then the upper age limit as on date of enrolment should be 21 years for candidates with 10+2/ Intermediate/ Equivalent including vocational course and 24 Years for candidates holding Diploma/ B.Sc in Pharmacy.
																Kindly Read the Notification For More Details.
															
															
														
														
															
															Eligibility Criteria

															
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with 10+2) : Candidate should have passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and with 50% marks in English.
																OR
																Should have passed two years’ Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects i.e. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
															

															 

															
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy):- Candidate with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy. Candidate should have passed Intermediate/ 10+2/ Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. In addition, Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy with minimum 50% marks in aggregate with valid registration from State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) at the time of enrolment will be mandatory requirement.
															
															
														
														
															
															Physical Eligibility Details

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For candidates
																up to the age of 21 Years) and 7 minutes 30 Seconds (For candidates above 21 years of age and holding Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy). In addition, Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats within the stipulated time to qualify in the Physical Fitness Test.
																Note: Candidates are advised to bring their sports shoes and shorts/track pant. Detailed procedure on expected
																technique for Push Ups, Sit Ups and Squats is available on CASB web portal www.airmenselection.cdac.in.
															

															 

															
																Height : Minimum acceptable height is 152.5 cms.
																Chest : The chest should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 5 cms
																Weight :Proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points
																Visual Standards: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error Not exceeding + 3.50D including Astigmatism
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection 

															
																Pay Scale: Rs.26,900/- per month
																Selection Process: Physical Fitness Test, Written Test, Adaptability Test – II & Medical Appointments

		Visit the official IAF recruitment website iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
		Click on the Candidate Login / Exam City Slip / Admit Card link for Agniveervayu / Airmen Medical Assistant Intake 02/2027.

		Take a colour printout and carry it to the exam centre along with original Aadhaar / valid photo ID.
	

	Note: Exam City Slip is not the Admit Card. Check all details carefully and contact the official helpline for any issue.

																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with 10+2) : Candidate should have passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and with 50% marks in English.
																OR
																Should have passed two years’ Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects i.e. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
															

															 

															
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy):- Candidate with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy. 																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For candidates
																up to the age of 21 Years) and 7 minutes 30 Seconds (For candidates above 21 years of age and holding Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy). In addition, Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats within the stipulated time to qualify in the Physical Fitness Test.

																Chest : The chest should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 5 cms

																Visual Standards: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error Not exceeding + 3.50D including Astigmatism

																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with 10+2):- Candidate should be unmarried and born  between 01 July 2006 and 01 July 2010 (both dates inclusive).

																In case, a candidate clear all the stages of the Selection Procedure, then the upper age limit as on date of enrolment should be 21 years for candidates with 10+2/ Intermediate/ Equivalent including vocational course and 24 Years for candidates holding Diploma/ B.Sc in Pharmacy.

																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with 10+2) : Candidate should have passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and with 50% marks in English.
																OR
																Should have passed two years’ Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects i.e. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
															

															 

															
																Medical Assistant trade (For candidates with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy):- Candidate with Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy. Candidate should have passed Intermediate/ 10+2/ Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. 																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For candidates
																up to the age of 21 Years) and 7 minutes 30 Seconds (For candidates above 21 years of age and holding Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy). In addition, Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats within the stipulated time to qualify in the Physical Fitness Test.

																Height : Minimum acceptable height is 152.5 cms.
																Chest : The chest should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 5 cms
																Weight :Proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points
																Visual Standards: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error Not exceeding + 3.50D including Astigmatism

																Pay Scale: Rs.26,900/- per month
																Selection Process: Physical Fitness Test, Written Test, Adaptability Test – II & Medical Appointments
